metric_lag.evidence_id: schema carries sec_accepted_at_utc and filing_timestamp_utc (provider times flagged unverified by the downloader); acceptance time is the governing clock

vintage.evidence_id: static competition-supplied artifact; amendments flagged by is_amendment rather than overwriting

coverage.evidence_id: spec 9.8: the supplied 8-K corpus has an officially acknowledged survivorship defect

unresolved_questions: COVERAGE (binding): the survivorship defect (spec 9.8) means filings from certain exited names may be absent. Required before formation use: the delisting test (Sears, Bon-Ton, Pier 1, GNC, Ascena, J.C. Penney must resolve) and the covered-vs-uncovered return comparison. Treatment if used anyway must be disclosed with sensitivity.
IDENTITY: identifier enrichment carries identifier_quality_flags and characteristics_link_date; links must be validated as dated rather than assumed (spec 9.5).

TIMES: provider filing times are unverified per the schema metadata (midnight may be a placeholder); use sec_accepted_at_utc where possible and treat date-only events per the t+1 convention (spec 2.2).
